description: Timeline token distribution overview shows cache hit rate per span and splits tokens into uncached input, cached read, cache write and output.
quote: It breaks down LLM span token usage by type — uncached input, cached read, cache write, and output — and shows cache hit rate per span
note: Braintrust already has metrics.prompt_cached_tokens and prompt_cache_creation_tokens; this adds the derived hit rate. Page gives month only (April 2026).

description: Built-in topic map classifying emotional tone of traces.
quote: Built-in topic maps include Task (user intents), Sentiment (emotional tone), and Issues (agent problems).
note: Topics classify logs by clustering model summaries; not a numeric evaluator. Page gives month only (February 2026).

description: Built-in topic map that classifies agent problems found in traces.
quote: Built-in topic maps include Task (user intents), Sentiment (emotional tone), and Issues (agent problems).
note: Classification of agent problems, no matching unique metric. Same entry also lists Task (user intents), judged out of scope as intent classification. Month only (February 2026).

description: Coding-agent plugin spans record reasoning tokens (named completion_reasoning_tokens on pi model-call spans).
quote: On pi model call spans, `reasoning_tokens` is now `completion_reasoning_tokens`
note: Only for spans produced by Braintrust coding-agent plugins (pi, Grok: v0.0.3 adds reasoning tokens), not general tracing. Rename of the earlier field reasoning_tokens. Month only (September 2026).
